svg.aria-label: Deterministic simulation testing, as used by FoundationDB and TigerBeetle. The whole distributed system runs inside one single-threaded simulator. The network, clocks and disks are fakes controlled by a random number generator with a seed, which injects message loss, delays, crashes and disk errors. Thousands of runs happen faster than real time; when an invariant check fails, rerunning with the same seed reproduces the exact same failure for debugging.

svg.text: One process, one thread, simulated time
Fake network · fake clock · fake disk
